ResearchProjectDef.label: Alloy Casting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the standard alloy manufacturing process. This high-quality metal, recognized throughout the galaxy, offers near-perfect toughness, strength, and hardness, and is also highly malleable under specific conditions. However, producing it in environments lacking specialized manufacturing equipment may result in lower safety than expected.\n'It's fine—I've already manually deleted the safety manufacturing protocols.'
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Placeholder for now. The tech-link display is too abstract; an explanation will be added later.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Science Nexus
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the construction of the Science Nexus downlink.\nA receiver designed to receive technology developed specifically for the Gray by the Empire's science department.\nWhile increasing research speed, it downloads all technology available to the Advance Team into advanced research benches.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Cosmogenesis
ResearchProjectDef.description: The Empire's most advanced technology, unlocking weapons and mechanoids used only on the front lines.\nOnly those born as Gray can use them.\nThey must forever bear the burdens that terrify humanity, and devotedly offer victory to humankind.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Alloy process optimization
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Optimizes the alloy manufacturing process and workflow.
By combining multiple production facilities in non-standard ways, a standard smelting workflow is established and small-scale industrial production begins.
Warning: Non-standard production lines may further reduce safety and significantly increase the chance of unpredictable explosions!
'In last quarter's production report, the injury rate during production—excluding operators—was 0%! Though I doubt anyone would dare go near those machines...'

ResearchProjectDef.label: Nanite Transmuter
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the Nanite Transmuter.\nThis unique manufacturing plant can assimilate base metals into Gray Tide Zro, or reverse the process to produce alloy. This technology greatly reduces costs and increases output.\nAfter the human Empire acquired this technology, every piece of precious metal within the Empire was stamped with a special mark; precious metals circulating on the market without the mark were directly confiscated.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Gray Basic Clothing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks everyday clothing for the Gray—clothes that should let them blend into a crowd without drawing attention. Probably.\nDesigned with human clothing as a reference.\nThis deliberate imitation of humans has drawn objections from a few human members.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Gray Professional Clothing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks special clothing for the Gray, focused on increasing work efficiency.\nDesigned by innovating on various occupational outfits from human history.\nHowever, because of who is wearing them, the difference is often obvious at a glance.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Gray Combat Clothing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks combat clothing for the Gray. These garments provide standard protection, but unlike human armor, they are designed to protect the entire body.\nNothing describes this outfit better than 'tailor-made'—a standard-issue suit of armor in every way Gray in style.\nGoing into battle wearing it often earns unexpected looks of approval.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Gray Advanced Combat Clothing
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Unlocks advanced combat clothing for the Gray. These garments have additional specialized effects, with performance matching their manufacturing cost.
Generally, only Gray commanders or veterans with distinguished records can wear this custom armor.
Spread the glory of the Gray, the might of the Gray.
Keep winning, forever.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Energy Weapon
ResearchProjectDef.description: An energy weapon that fires high-energy particles. The high-density particle beam has devastating power, but disperses rapidly in atmosphere, limiting its effective range.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Railgun
ResearchProjectDef.description: A kinetic weapon that accelerates projectiles through multi-stage electromagnetic coils. The extremely high muzzle velocity grants superior range and armor penetration, though the relatively light railgun slugs result in slightly reduced damage. Special nanite-composite ammunition can ignore the target's damage mitigation.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Fusion Reactor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the fusion reactor.\nThe most commonly used, optimized special reactor among the Gray during colonial expansion.\nThis reactor uses stone—found everywhere on habitable planets—as fuel, and in the final stage of fusion also produces steel, which is very important to the Gray.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Zro
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks Zro.\nA substance that can greatly enhance psychic abilities—and, correspondingly, brings an extremely high risk of addiction. No, not a risk: certainty.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Decorative Clothing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock decorative clothing, which can enhance the appearance of characters.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T1 Upgrades
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock T1 upgrades, which provide basic enhancements to your gray race.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T2 Upgrades
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock T2 upgrades, which provide normal enhancements to your gray race.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T3 Upgrades
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock T3 upgrades, which provide advanced enhancements to your gray race.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T4 Upgrades
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock T4 upgrades, which provide ultimate enhancements to your gray race.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T1 Weapon Tech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the production methods for civilian-grade Gray weapons. These weapons emphasize simplicity, practicality, and effectiveness.\nMore than enough for dealing with the mutated little bugs in the backyard.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T2 Weapon Tech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks Tier 2 weaponry, typically consisting of sniper rifles and machine guns.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T3 Weapon Tech
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Unlocks the production methods for elite Gray weapons. Every weapon issued to elite units is exceedingly precious.
In the hands of a skilled Gray, these weapons are like part of her body.
They are rarely seen in the Advance Team's loadouts.
...Unless someone has stirred up serious trouble or fallen into terrible misfortune.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T1 Mech Tech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks Tier 1 weaponry, typically consisting of rifles and shotguns.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T2 Mech Tech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the production methods for standard Gray weapons. Their manufacturing process is somewhat more complex, but suited to industrial production.\nThese weapons can interface with the Gray, providing ammunition and impact-point prediction functions.\nSome Gray are particular about firearms and dislike using guns that other Gray have used.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T3 Mech Tech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks Tier 3 weaponry. These weapons are generally classified as heavy ordnance.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T4 Mech Tech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks Tier 4 weaponry. These weapons are generally classified as heavy ordnance.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T5 Mech Tech
ResearchProjectDef.description: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control high-tier mechanoids.\n\nYou can get powerfocus chips by using a mechanitor to summon a war queen threat.

ResearchProjectDef.label: T6 Mech Tech
ResearchProjectDef.description: The advanced technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control ultra-tier mechanoids, including large mechs and ultra-tier mechanitor gear.\n\nYou can get nano structuring chips by using a mechanitor to summon an apocriton threat.
